propers.text:
Intercessio nos, quaesumus, Domine, beati Antonii Abbatis commendet: ut,
quod nostris meritis non valemus, ejus patrocinio assequamur. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.text: Lord, we ask that the intercession of blessed Anthony the Abbot may commend us, so that we may attain through his protection what we cannot achieve by our own merits. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in unity.

propers.name: Offertory
propers.text:
Desiderium animae eius tribuisti ei, Domine, et voluntate labiorum
eius non fraudasti eum: posuisti in capite eius coronam de lapide
pretioso.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Protegat nos, Domine, cum tui perceptione sacramenti beatus Antonius Abbas,
pro nobis intercedendo: ut et conversationis ejus experiamur insignia, et
intercessionis percipiamus suffragia. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: As we receive your sacrament, Lord, may blessed Anthony the Abbot protect us by interceding for us, so that we may both come to know by experience the outstanding qualities of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in unity.
